text:
jen_sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth POC needs SOC 2 Type II cover letter and ISO 27001 scope doc for procurement review. Can we assemble something sharable by Thursday EOD?

mohit_se: Timeline noted. They need it for legal review — any constraints on what we can include?

aria_security: We can provide a SOC2 summary PDF and a redacted SOC2 letter, plus the ISO scope PDF. Raw vuln reports are not included in public bundles. For pen-test we can produce a signed attestation/letter (redacted) — requires infosec sign-off.

sam_solutions: Do they want a secure share or SFTP? They asked for an encrypted zip via SFTP in their email.

jen_sales: They prefer SFTP, but presigned S3 link is also ok for procurement. Also a pricing question: they're evaluating Dedicated — does that change what's in the assurance bundle or the timeline?

aria_security: Dedicated vs hosted doesn't change SOC/ISO artifacts we can share. For Dedicated we can add additional network/topology docs and deployment notes (no privileged access). Pen-test letter process is the same — we redact specifics.

mohit_se: I can draft network diagrams and the dedicated pricing appendix. If we include the dedicated quote, note that pricing is subject to a 3-month ramp commitment.

aria_security: For the pen-test letter I need the scope (internal/external) and last test date. Our records: internal scan 2025-10-12; third-party pentest 2025-04-03. Draft attestation will state vendor name, date, and that findings were remediated or triaged.

jen_sales: Perfect. Can we do presigned S3 link with 7-day expiry as a stopgap? If legal insists on SFTP later we can swap. Also procurement sent their NDA — @maria_legal is OOO today.

aria_security: We can upload a redacted bundle without an NDA. Full reports require a signed NDA. Recommend uploading the redacted bundle to S3 and offering the NDA route for full access.

deploy-bot: Artifact upload complete: presigned link -> https://presigned.s3.aws/redwood-sales/acmehealth-assurance-2026-03-21.zip (expires in 7 days).

jen_sales: Thanks. @mohit_se can you confirm the bundle contents: SOC2-summary.pdf, iso_scope.pdf, network-diagram.png, pen-test-letter-draft.pdf (redacted), kms_hsm_summary.txt, and dedicated-quote-acme.pdf?

mohit_se: Confirmed. I also added a short data-flow diagram and a minimal certs list. Dedicated quote includes note about 3-month ramp pricing.

aria_security: I'll review the pen-test-letter-draft and sign it by EOD. Draft snippet in letter: 
```
Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was performed by <vendor> on 2025-04-03. Findings were remediated or entered into our triage pipeline. We do not include raw vulnerability reports in the public artifact bundle; full reports may be provided to customers under a signed NDA.
```

sam_solutions: I'll add a short README describing redactions and how to request further details via NDA. Also added Zendesk link for tracking.

jen_sales: I'll send the presigned link to the customer and note that full reports are available under NDA. Logging to Zendesk ticket #12345.

sam_solutions: Zendesk ticket added: https://zendesk.redwood.com/agent/tickets/12345

jen_sales: :thumbsup:

(next day) jen_sales: Update — AcmeHealth accepted the redacted bundle but asked for a short blurb about KMS/HSM key custody. @mohit_se can you add a concise paragraph?

mohit_se: Done — added kms_hsm_summary.txt to the zip with a 3-line explanation of KMS usage, HSM options for Dedicated, and contact for compliance follow-up.

aria_security: Pen-test letter signed and uploaded. Updated presigned link.

jen_sales: Great — they acknowledged receipt and will escalate to procurement. I'll follow up if they request full reports or legal redlines.

sam_solutions: Noted. Closing loop here unless they ask for additional items.
